title: EOSC Node Germany – Coming soon
main_text: Scope The German EOSC Node provides seamless access to high-quality FAIR data and specialised services from all science areas, it connects NFDI and other national infrastructures to the EOSC Federation. Intended Users European researchers, connecting to German science organisations and service providers by joining the EOSC Federation through integrated AAI connectivity. Responsible organisation NFDI embodies the community-driven endeavour by all science areas: Data as a common good for excellent research, organised by science in Germany.
